# ProjectManager shift report — shift 5 (2026-11-18, 16:33Z)

# TL; DR;

**In plain terms:** nothing was due, so I spent the shift checking whether the work we are about to ship is really *one* increment. It is not — and that is this shift's finding.

**Status: at risk** (unchanged cause: no Node anywhere).

- **The real change today:** the code waiting to be committed is **65 files, +2219/-221**, and it contains **four unrelated features plus a major package upgrade**. Committing it as one thing would mean the efforts work cannot be demoed, or undone, on its own. That breaks our own rule. I raised card `0bc8b144` to commit **only the 3 efforts files + 1 hunk of `package.json`**.
- **Three card descriptions were wrong** and are now corrected: the file path (it is `kanban/TaskSettings.vue`), the test count (9 cases, not 8), and step 1 of the Node card (the test script **already exists** — nobody should re-add it). A wrong description on a card is how a shift "passes" without doing the work.
- **Still the only blocker:** no Node runtime, so the 9 tests cannot run. Devops card `91411767`, wake 11-19 10:30 Madrid.

**Decisions I took without a human:** D5 — commit by explicit pathspec, unrelated work stays uncommitted (reversible; overridable until Thursday 17:00Z). The demo slot is still a **switch, not a promise**: it flips to Monday 11-23 if Node has not landed by Thursday 12:00Z.

---

## 1. Summary
No item was due. I converted tomorrow's work from "trust the card" into "verify against the tree", and added the missing scope-control card. Business outcome: the efforts increment can be shown and reverted on its own instead of hiding inside 2 200 unreviewed lines.

## 2. Scope
- **In this increment:** `91411767` (Node), `675c4695` (HIGH comment), `a0f362ed` (run tests), `d4e3a041` (test suite), `fcf65219` (remove() fix), **`0bc8b144` (commit scope — new)**.
- **Out:** `79a1336d`, `94d15daf`, `8a554fa4`, `b19676fe`, `3a86fba9` (platform gates/tooling — cannot be fixed inside this repo), `61098a6b` (cleanup, 11-21).

## 3. Increment plan

| Milestone | Deliverable | Owner | Date (Madrid) | Deployable | Demoable | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1a | Node available to the test runner | devops `91411767` | 11-19 10:30 | yes | `node --version` | doing — **critical path**; script step already done |
| M1b | HIGH comment deleted (`kanban/TaskSettings.vue:183-185`, -3/+0) | software_developer `675c4695` | 11-19 10:22 | yes — deletion only | CISO `allow / 0 findings` | doing — coordinates corrected |
| M1c | Run `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` explicitly, post output | software_developer `a0f362ed` | 11-19 15:00Z | n/a | 9 `ok -` lines, exit 0 | todo — count corrected |
| M1d | Efforts test suite (9 cases, +139 lines) | software_developer `d4e3a041` | 11-20 17:30 | yes | with M1c | doing, **60 %** (was 80 — unverified cannot be 80) |
| M1e | `EffortsSettings.remove()` fixed | software_developer `fcf65219` | 11-19 10:04 | yes | delete a preset | doing — no evidence yet |
| M1f | **Commit by pathspec: 3 files + 1 hunk** | software_developer `0bc8b144` | 11-19 13:00Z | yes — 3 files revert cleanly | `git show --stat` = 3 files | **todo — new** |

## 4. Dependencies & critical path
`91411767` → `a0f362ed` → `d4e3a041` → `0bc8b144` → Review. `675c4695` is independent of Node and strictly **upstream of the commit** (the HIGH sits on added lines 183-185 — confirmed from the diff hunk `@@ -181,0 +182,64 @@`, not inferred). Critical path remains entirely M1a.

## 5. Risks

| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Owner | Decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 no Node in any container (measured 4×) | tests never executed, no proof for the demo | high | `91411767`; gate 11-19 12:00Z; demo flips to Monday on evidence | devops | **yes (D3)** |
| R4 HIGH comment lands on the branch | security finding shipped | low | commit strictly after M1b | PM | D4 |
| R5 **widened** — one 65-file commit mixes 4 features + a major bump | efforts cannot be demoed or reverted alone | **high if unmanaged** | `0bc8b144` pathspec commit | PM | **D5** |
| R8 **new** — `node --test tests/` also pulls 6 untracked, never-run voice suites | red run with no relation to efforts, false blocker | medium | run the single file explicitly; report the wider run separately | a0f362ed owner | no |

## 6. Decisions needed from management
1. **D5 — commit scope.** Options: (a) pathspec commit of the 3 efforts files + 1 hunk; (b) commit everything; (c) wait until all features are finished. **Recommend (a)** — reversible, demoable, no waiting. Decide by **Thu 11-19 17:00Z** (default applies if silent).
2. **D3 — demo slot.** Stays Thursday if Node lands by Thu 12:00Z, otherwise Monday 11-23. **Recommend keeping it a switch.** Decide by **Thu 11-19 12:00Z**.

## 7. Next checkpoint & demo
- **11-19 12:00Z** — gate `ed8d3ebb`, now with six explicit pass/fail checks (amended this shift).
- **11-19 13:00Z** — `0bc8b144` commit.
- **11-20 16:00Z** — `8eded1c4`, the single go/no-go.
- Demo needs: Node version string, 9 `ok -` lines, CISO `allow / 0 findings`, `git show --stat` = 3 files.

## Evidence collected this shift
- `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` — 631 lines, +123/-0 vs HEAD; HIGH comment on **added** lines 183-185. The path `src/components/TaskSettings.vue` in card `675c4695` **does not exist**.
- `package.json` (:14) already has `"test": "node --test tests/"` (+2/-1); same diff carries `vue3-virtual-scroller ^0.2.3 → ^2.0.3` (:64).
- `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` — added, +139 lines, exactly **9** `test(` cases (list/fields/load/load-encoding/create/save/delete/propagation/per-instance).
- `tests/` also holds 6 **untracked** suites: `voiceBargeIn|voiceCommands|voiceLanguage|voiceProgress|voiceSpeech|voiceWait.test.mjs`.
- Tree scope `src/` + `tests/` + `package.json`: **65 files, +2219/-221**.
- Stray files still present: `tmp-typecheck-report.mjs`, `tmp-calendar-compile-check.mjs` (card `61098a6b` widened accordingly).

## Shift report

**Done:** verified the three card facts against the tree and corrected them on the cards (`675c4695` path, `a0f362ed` count + node discovery warning, `91411767` step 1 already done); measured the commit surface (65 files / +2219/-221); created `0bc8b144` (pathspec commit, wake 11-19 13:00Z, due 11-19); amended gate `ed8d3ebb` to six pass/fail checks including the new commit card; corrected `d4e3a041` progress 80 → 60; widened `61098a6b` (at least three temp files). No files changed in the repository.

**Scheduled:** `ed8d3ebb` 11-19 12:00Z (gate, 6 items) · `0bc8b144` 11-19 13:00Z (commit) · `8eded1c4` 11-20 16:00Z (go/no-go).

**Blocked:** `91411767` — no Node in any container, and the apt route is closed (non-root, dpkg lock). Needs a devops decision on the base image; I cannot fix that from this repository.

## PM shift 5 — addendum (turn 3, 2026-11-18T16:40Z) — **supersedes section 4 and row M1b/M1f of the report above**

The report on this card was written before one last measurement. That measurement **changed the plan**, in our favour on one axis and against us on another. Read this addendum as authoritative.

### What changed: the HIGH finding is NOT in the pending commit

Verified by diff, not inference:
- `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` is **+123/-0** and that entire diff is the **recurrence** feature.
- The HIGH comment (lines 183-185) is an **added line inside that recurrence hunk** `@@ -181,0 +182,64 @@`.
- The efforts commit `0bc8b144` **excludes** that file.

Therefore `675c4695` **no longer blocks the efforts commit**. It blocks the recurrence commit.

### Corrected increment plan

| Milestone | Deliverable | Owner | Date (Madrid) | Deployable | Demoable | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1a | Node available to the test runner | devops `91411767` | 11-19 10:30 | yes | `node --version` | doing — **still the only critical path** |
| M1b | HIGH comment deleted (`TaskSettings.vue:183-185`, -3/+0) | software_developer `675c4695` | **11-21 16:39Z (deferred)** | yes | CISO `allow / 0 findings` | doing — **off the critical path**, folded into recurrence |
| M1c | Run `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` explicitly | software_developer `a0f362ed` | 11-19 15:00Z | n/a | 9 `ok -` lines, exit 0 | todo |
| M1d | Efforts test suite (9 cases, +139) | software_developer `d4e3a041` | 11-20 17:30 | yes | with M1c | doing, 60 % |
| M1e | `EffortsSettings.remove()` fixed | software_developer `fcf65219` | 11-19 10:04 | yes | delete a preset | **code exists (+8/-1), unproven** |
| M1f | Commit **4 paths**: `efforts.js`, `global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`, `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`, **1** `package.json` hunk | software_developer `0bc8b144` | 11-19 13:00Z | yes | `git show --stat` = 4 paths, bump still uncommitted | todo |

### New facts recorded this turn
- **M1e has code**: `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` **+8/-1** (folder is `global_settings`, not `kanban`). Written, not verified.
- **Corrected path** on `0bc8b144`: the real file is `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`. The hunk-split recipe (`git apply --cached` on a filtered `package.json` patch) is now on that card, so tomorrow cannot stall on `git add -p`.
- **Gate `ed8d3ebb` checks 3 and 6 replaced**: `TaskSettings.vue` being **absent** from the commit is now a *pass* condition; the `vue3-virtual-scroller` bump still being uncommitted is the proof the split worked.
- **New card `f949754f`** (IT team / Inbox, wake 11-23 16:39Z): the **recurrence** work has no commit path of its own. Untracked +2219/-221 including a known HIGH finding is how a finding lands by accident.

### Risk table delta
| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R10 **new** — recurrence work has no commit card and carries a HIGH finding | finding ships by accident in a future broad commit | medium | `f949754f`; deletion folded in before that commit | no |
| R4 **narrowed** — was "commit before HIGH fixed" | now impossible for this commit: the finding is not in it | low | gate check 3 asserts absence | D4 closed for this increment |
| R7 **changed** — M1b owner edits a file another owner is actively changing | edit collision in a 631-line SFC | medium | `675c4695` deferred to 11-21, fold into recurrence, delete-not-reword ruling on the card | no |

### Decisions
- **D4 is now closed for this increment** (nothing to sequence — the finding is outside the commit). It stays open for the recurrence commit.
- **D3 and D5 unchanged.** D5's scope is now **4 paths**, stated exactly.

**No repository files changed this turn.** All corrections are on the cards.

## PM shift 5 — closing addendum (turn 4, 2026-11-18T16:45Z) — schedule correction

One defect remained in the plan after the previous addendum, and it is the kind that would only surface tomorrow, at 13:00Z, with the commit already made.

**Defect:** `a0f362ed` ("run the tests") was scheduled to wake **11-20 14:00Z**. The commit card `0bc8b144` fires **11-19 13:00Z**. The gate was going to open **25 hours before** the proof it guards. M1c was, in practice, not on the critical path at all — it was after the finish line.

**Fix (applied):** `a0f362ed` re-woken to **11-19 12:30Z**, priority raised to high, due date pulled to 11-19. It now sits between the Node gate (`ed8d3ebb`, 12:00Z) and the commit (13:00Z).

**Corrected ordering for 11-19 (Madrid = UTC+1):**

| UTC | Madrid | Card | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|
| 09:04 | 10:04 | `fcf65219` | `EffortsSettings.remove()` — behavioural proof (delete a preset) |
| 09:30 | 10:30 | `91411767` | Node runtime — `node --version` |
| 12:00 | 13:00 | `ed8d3ebb` | **Gate** — 6 pass/fail checks; flips the demo switch |
| 12:30 | 13:30 | `a0f362ed` | Run `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` → 9 `ok -` lines |
| 13:00 | 14:00 | `0bc8b144` | Commit 4 paths — **hard-guarded on the 12:30Z evidence** |

**Guard recorded on the commit card:** if `a0f362ed` is `onhold` with `BLOCKED: node not found`, `0bc8b144` must **not** commit. We do not commit code we could not run. This converts D3 from a judgement call into a mechanical rule.

**Deferred, unchanged:** `675c4695` → 11-21 16:39Z (recurrence edit-collision avoidance); `f949754f` → 11-23 16:39Z (recurrence commit scope).

**Net effect on the increment:** nothing about the *content* changed this shift after the previous addendum — only the *order*. That order was wrong and is now right.
